text:
Type: oak chest of four drawers
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for a lamp or decor; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, minimalist
Materials: white-stained oak veneer, solid oak drawer lips
Colors: light natural oak, pale honey beige
Shape: upright boxy cabinet with four equal deep drawers, each front capped by a slanted overhanging lip that serves as the pull, set on a recessed wooden plinth with block feet, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, calm, natural, orderly
Goes with: white walls, linen bedding, light wood floors, green plants; Scandinavian or Japandi bedrooms

product.name: OPPLAND
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
